description: Use when the user no longer wants an open offer resting on the XP marketplace -- 'cancel that open offer for tickets to the game', 'stop waiting on those'. Closes it to new fills. Fills it already took are completed purchases and are not undone. For an offer on one listing, use cancel_my_offer instead. Two-phase: confirm=false previews, confirm=true commits. Requires auth.

confirm.description: False (default) previews. True closes the offer to new fills.

open_offer_id.description: The standing_bid_id of an open offer, from list_my_open_offers.

name: cancel_my_open_offer
title: Cancel My Open Offer
